text:
Which statement is correct?
A
Bitumen is used as a fuel for ships.
B
Coal, natural gas and oxygen are all fuels.
C
Hydrogen is the main constituent of natural gas.
D
Petroleum is separated into useful substances by fractional distillation.

options.label: A
options.text: Bitumen is used as a fuel for ships.

options.label: B
options.text: Coal, natural gas and oxygen are all fuels.

options.label: C
options.text: Hydrogen is the main constituent of natural gas.

options.label: D
options.text: Petroleum is separated into useful substances by fractional distillation.
